CSS Q&A.q: What is the CSS Box Model?
CSS Q&A.a: Every element is represented as a rectangular box consisting of Content, Padding, Border, and Margin from the inside out.

CSS Q&A.q: Explain the difference between Flexbox and Grid.
CSS Q&A.a: Flexbox is designed for 1-dimensional layouts (rows OR columns), while Grid is designed for 2-dimensional layouts (rows AND columns).
